title: uf/{head_id}/wishability payload
description: UPSERT payload of uf/{head_id}/wishability: how much the user wants the figure, as MFC's Wishability rates it. Clearing it is a DELETE. Serialized, at most 139 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
